# Vendored third-party assets

Pinned, served locally (no runtime CDN) for CSP-friendliness and supply-chain
integrity.

| File | Library | Version | License | Source |
|------|---------|---------|---------|--------|
| `lightweight-charts.standalone.production.js` | TradingView Lightweight Charts | 4.1.3 | Apache-2.0 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/lightweight-charts@4.1.3/dist/lightweight-charts.standalone.production.js |

To update: re-download the pinned version, review the license header, and bump
the version here.
